caption: The preview shows three source pages, proposed local links, and unresolved URLs.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['craft-link-repair']; window.__craftModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings = { folder: 'Craft Link Repair/Export', outputFolder: '', dateFolder: '', dateFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD', automatic: false }; p.receipts = {}; p.lastResult = null; for (const f of app.vault.getFiles().filter(f => f.path.startsWith('Craft Link Repair/Export/') && (/\.repaired\.md$/.test(f.path) || /\/Craft repair report(?: \d+)?\.md$/.test(f.path)))) await app.vault.delete(f); await p.saveSettings(); window.__craftModal = p.openPreview(); [...window.__craftModal.contentEl.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent === 'Preview links').click(); const end = Date.now()+30000; while (!window.__craftModal.contentEl.querySelector('.craft-repair-summary')) { if (Date.now()>end) throw new Error('Preview did not finish'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } return 'ok'; })()

caption: The repaired Atlas copy has local links. The source note stays intact.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['craft-link-repair']; [...window.__craftModal.contentEl.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Write copies').click(); const stop=Date.now()+30000; while (!p.lastResult) { if(Date.now()>stop) throw new Error('Write did not finish'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } if(p.lastResult.failures.length) throw new Error(p.lastResult.failures.join('; ')); window.__craftModal?.close(); await app.workspace.getLeaf(false).setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:"Craft Link Repair/Export/Atlas.textbundle/text.repaired.md",mode:'preview'}}); return 'ok'; })()
